purpose: Verification of the 4.09 GB Ito 2021 raw archive and of the committed verification ledger that described it.
note: Timestamps are deliberately omitted: this package must be byte-reproducible. Ordering is established by git history.

ledgerReproduction.conclusion: The committed PASS was a TRUTHFUL record of an archive the repository could not prove it possessed. Gate status moves from BLOCKED / NOT RUN to genuinely earned PASS.

limitationRetained.issue: No SHA-256 for this tier exists anywhere in the repository. MD5 establishes accidental-corruption integrity, NOT adversarial provenance.

contributedByThisAudit.note: Computed by an oracle independent of the repository's scripts so a stronger pin is available. NOT yet adopted by any gate.

honestContrast: scripts/verify-ito-raw-archive.py:33-34 hard-exits on a missing cache and never fabricates a pass. This script is honest; the X01 report gate is not.
writeBeforeFailHazard: Lines 77-78 write both tracked ledger copies BEFORE the raise SystemExit(1) at line 81. A failing archive would therefore overwrite a committed PASS ledger with a FAIL. Not triggered here because the archive passed, but the hazard is real and unfixed.
uncertainty: Downloaded once from one mirror. Not independently re-downloaded to exclude a stable upstream substitution.
alternativeExplanation: An adversarially substituted archive colliding on MD5 while preserving byte count and 505 member CRCs is not excluded by MD5 alone; the SHA-256 above closes this going forward.
independentlyReproduced: Hashing was performed both by PowerShell Get-FileHash and by the repository's own streaming implementation, in agreement.
